title: Adam’s Echo
description: Something in the world has started answering back.
body:
Something is wrong with the old woods.

This mod is a quiet horror mod that changes familiar Minecraft landscapes into places that feel watched, remembered, and no longer entirely safe. Across plains, forests, and forgotten structures, strange presences may appear in the fog — sometimes distant, sometimes closer than expected.

The mod is built around atmosphere, uncertainty, and slow tension rather than constant jumpscares. Some events are rare. Some signs are subtle. Some things are better left unexplained.

## Features

- Biome-based horror encounters
- Foggy plains and forest atmosphere
- Strange entities and distant presences
- Abandoned houses and unsettling structures
- Sound, visibility, and observation-based tension
- Designed to blend into normal survival gameplay
- Intentionally vague mechanics for discovery

## Important

Adam’s Echo does not explain everything.

The less you know, the better it works.

For the best experience, play in survival, keep your render distance moderate, and avoid looking up entity behavior before playing.

## Status

Currently in beta.  
Expect changes, balancing updates, and additional encounters in future versions.

Please report crashes, performance issues, unusual spawning behavior, or moments that feel confusing rather than unsettling.
